import sys
input = sys.stdin.read

def max_not_disappointed_people(n, times):
    times.sort()
    current_time = 0
    not_disappointed = 0
    
    for time in times:
        if current_time <= time:
            not_disappointed += 1
            current_time += time
    
    return not_disappointed

data = input().split()
n = int(data[0])
times = list(map(int, data[1:n+1]))

result = max_not_disappointed_people(n, times)
print(result)
